biomarkers.name: PD-L1 amplification (9p24.1) / CIITA rearrangements
biomarkers.prevalence: 9p24.1/PD-L1/PD-L2 copy-number gain or amplification is common; CIITA rearrangements occur in a minority (~20%)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Shared with cHL biology. Pembrolizumab approved for R/R PMBL (KEYNOTE-013/-170). CIITA rearrangements disrupt MHC-II, immune evasion

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.prevalence: Frequently positive (~70-80%), usually heterogeneous/weaker than cHL
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic support; brentuximab vedotin has shown activity in R/R PMBL, but is not a standard biomarker-selected therapy in the way it is for cHL/ALCL

biomarkers.name: JAK2, PDL1, PDL2 co-amplification on 9p24.1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Shared with cHL — JAK-STAT and PD-1 pathway activation

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Diffuse infiltrate of medium to large B cells with clear cytoplasm ('fried egg' appearance in some cases) in dense fibrous stroma; arises from thymic B cells
variants: grey zone lymphoma / mediastinal grey zone lymphoma (B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between PMBCL and cHL)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Shared biology with cHL — 9p24.1 alterations with PD-L1/PD-L2 overexpression, JAK-STAT activation, and CIITA rearrangements causing reduced MHC-II expression; pembrolizumab active in R/R (KEYNOTE-013/-170)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Dense fibrous compartmentalising stroma is characteristic; bulky anterior mediastinal mass

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Thymic B cells (distinct from typical DLBCL) — the thymic medulla contains resident B cells with specialised function in T-cell tolerance
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Medium to large B cells with clear cytoplasm ('fried egg' appearance in some cases) in dense fibrous stroma; retains B-cell markers (CD19+, CD20+, CD22+, PAX5+); CD30+ variable
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Thymic B-cell origin explains distinctive biology — shared with cHL: 9p24.1 alterations with PD-L1/PD-L2 overexpression, JAK-STAT activation, CIITA rearrangements causing reduced MHC-II expression; mediastinal grey zone lymphoma represents lineage transition between PMBCL and cHL
